label: Slim Chickens UK dietary/menu portal on TenKites (linked from slimchickens.co.uk footer as "Dietary Information") — schema.org JSON-LD Menu with NutritionInformation per item
notes: slimchickens.co.uk footer links "Dietary Information" -> https://menus.tenkites.com/brg/slimchickensall, which is a location picker; the actual core menu is /brg/slimscore?sitecode=SLM. That page embeds a single <script type="application/ld+json"> schema.org Menu covering the whole menu, each MenuItem carrying NutritionInformation with calories, proteinContent, fatContent, carbohydrateContent, saturatedFatContent. 212 MenuItem nutrition blocks, 103 unique name+macro rows. Plausibility check protein*4 <= kcal*1.15 passed on all rows (0 violations). Values are rounded to whole grams at source. Other TenKites site variants exist (slimshubs, slimsbelfast) for site-specific menus.
